study type: Cross-sectional study within a cohort initiative
outcome: Clinical correlates (lipid profile, glucose, blood pressure control)
cohort: The study included 37,436 adult subjects with type 1 diabetes (45.3% women) attending 282 Italian diabetes clinics.
finding: Obesity is frequent in adult T1D subjects, associated with higher cardiovascular disease risk factors, micro- and macrovascular complications, and lower quality of care, with T1D women having a higher risk of severe obesity.
